ctxTalking:
• ZetaChain’s decision to wind down its Cosmos-based L1 and move ZETA assets to Solana

ctxSignal:
Signal: Concrete migrations like ZetaChain’s and Solana’s mainnet upgrades show tangible ecosystem shifts.

ctxGlossary:
